newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Waterford half-yr pretax profit down 4.2pct.
newsitem.headline: Waterford half-yr pretax profit down 4.2pct.

text.p: NOTE - Waterford Foods said it is confronting the challenge of weak dairy markets and a competitive milk market, in line with the dairy sector generally.

The group said these market conditions were likely to exist for the remainder of 1996 but added that a restoration of balance between raw materials costs and market returns is in train and should improve margins in 1997.

Waterford said that its operating margin slipped to 4.2 percent in the first half of 1996 from 5.1 percent a year earlier. Interest cover was 2.3 times compared with 3.4 times in the first half of 1995 while gearing rose to 108 percent from 50 percent.
